definitions.explanation: Indicates that something cannot be done or is impossible. Most commonly used as a suffix attached to a noun (especially Sino-Japanese stem) to mean 'un-V-able' or 'impossible to V'.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧{不能|ふのう}だ。
⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧{不能|ふのう}な⟦{事態|じたい}→事態：10151_jitai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
⟦{回線|かいせん}→回線：11094_kaisen⟧⟦トラブル→トラブル：07061_toraburu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{操作|そうさ}→操作：03316_sousa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{一時|いちじ}→一時：01799_ichiji⟧{不能|ふのう}になっています。
examples.english: Due to network trouble, operations are temporarily disabled.

notes:
Composed of {不|ふ} (not) + ⟦{能|のう}→能：01927_nou⟧ (able). Most often used as the second element of a compound to negate a capability. Functions as a na-adjective when modifying a noun (⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧{不能|ふのう}な〜) and as a noun-predicate (⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧{不能|ふのう}だ).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧{不能|ふのう}: impossible to repair
- ⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧{不能|ふのう}: unpredictable
- ⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧{不能|ふのう}: unusable
- ⟦{再生|さいせい}→再生：04442_saisei⟧{不能|ふのう}: non-renewable; cannot be played back
- ⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧{不能|ふのう}: irrecoverable
- ⟦{実行|じっこう}→実行：03274_jikkou⟧{不能|ふのう}: unworkable; infeasible

COMMON PATTERNS:
- Noun + {不能|ふのう}な + Noun: an unX-able Y
- Noun + {不能|ふのう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become unable; to be disabled

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{不可|ふか}→不可：01922_fuka⟧: not allowed; impossible — emphasizes prohibition or unfeasibility (⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦{不可|ふか}→不可：01922_fuka⟧ not permitted to use)
- ⟦{不可能|ふかのう}→不可能：03144_fukanou⟧: impossible — stand-alone na-adjective; broader use
- ⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧: difficult — implies it is hard but not impossible
